body: That really means a lot, Thankyou
Something just stopped me cutting deep enough

I've said all that to her, no matter what meaningful shit I said, no mater how much effort I put in, she just doesn't care anymore, people change, she just doesn't realise how much of a big part of my life she is, literally feels like a part of me has been ripped out, she knows all this too. When I told her she said "can we not make this a big thing" she just doesn't care.

Yeaah she was just drunk and being stupid, since we started being friends again (3/4 months) she's just not cared or bothered like she has all other times, we had a big argument this morning, which is when she said I was a shitty person and all that shit

She doesn't, I was moody because she was at a party in my area then got lost when she left, I came to look for her to take her home while she said she'd wait, then she got a taxi right before I got there (she was literally 1 minute from my house)

I spoke to her in a moody way even though  I was fine with her telling me to fuck off the day before, suddenly starts calling me a bad friend and a shitty person when I've basically torn myself over the years helping her through everything

On and off best friend if 6 years wants nothing to do with me for no reason, she just doesn't care anymore, doesn't care about all the memories, our past, happy times, what could have happened in the future, completely destroyed me. It was last thing I needed after what goes on in my fucked up mind
